$description: score-king LIGHT semantic palette, restructured into the shared studio --semantic-* taxonomy (adopted from finance's design-tokens). Emitted as :root (the default). Brand stays JRM Studio: interactive = Royal Violet, accent = Crown Gold. Only accent-ink and the neutral surfaces differ meaningfully from dark.

raised.$description: JRM extension (deepest chrome surface) — preserves the legacy --color-surface-3 back-compat alias.

default.$description: Royal Violet — the one brand action color.
Crown Gold — leader & winner fills/washes (the Crown Gold Rule).

ink.$description: Pure Crown Gold fails WCAG on light surfaces — darken gold TEXT to #806600 while keeping gold fills as accent.default.

positive.$description: Light-theme positive. Uses the 700 step, not 500: 500 is tuned for dark surfaces and measures only 1.92:1 on white. 700 clears WCAG AA on every light surface — 6.46:1 on white, 5.75:1 on frost, 5.27:1 on haze — and 6.46:1 for white text placed on it as a fill.

negative.$description: Light-theme negative. Reaches real text through --button-danger-text, so the dark-tuned 500 step was body text at 2.77:1. 700 measures 6.42:1 on white, 5.71:1 on frost, 5.24:1 on haze, and 6.42:1 for white text on it as a fill.

warning.$description: Light-theme warning. Amber is an inherently low-luminance-contrast hue: the 700 step measures only 4.37:1 on haze, short of AA. The 800 step clears every light surface — 8.89:1 on white, 7.91:1 on frost, 7.25:1 on haze.

info.$description: Light-theme info. Sky behaves like amber here: the 700 step measures only 4.28:1 on haze, short of AA. The 800 step clears every light surface — 8.05:1 on white, 7.17:1 on frost, 6.57:1 on haze.

pending.$description: In-flight, processing, syncing, unsettled — distinct from warning because a pending operation is not a problem. 5.68:1 on white, 5.05:1 on frost, 4.63:1 on haze. Pair with an icon or label; never signal state by hue alone.

neutral.$description: Uncategorized or inactive status. 6.27:1 on white, 5.12:1 on haze.

positiveSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis positive fill for badges, banners, and toasts. Carries text.primary at 15.78:1.

negativeSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis negative fill. Carries text.primary at 15.61:1.

warningSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis warning fill. Carries text.primary at 15.71:1.

infoSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis info fill. Carries text.primary at 15.72:1.

pendingSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis pending fill. Carries text.primary at 15.73:1.

neutralSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis neutral fill for uncategorized badges.
